scientific_integrity: All-dimensional analytic ridge and coarea proof; finite direct checks corroborate, do not replace, proof. Canonical Euclidean metric only.
scientific_limitations: Requires r>=3 and every layer size >=2; no general ranked-poset, weighted-metric, or higher-Steiner-coefficient claim; absolute priority and independent audit remain unverified.
title: Layer-size universality of the first two Steiner coefficients of layered chain polytopes
